Title: Death and Duty
Description: Defeat the former Watcher Antonio Guerra, find any scouting reports at his camp, and put his soul to rest. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in the Mourningdale Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Is that so? Well you certainly look capable enough, and I’m in no position to turn away an able body.
InProgressResponse: Time is of the essence, friend. The Corrupted are gathering strength, and who knows what other forces array against us. Hurry!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So… this is it then? Antonio… lost to us. You’re sure? I suppose once this is all over, I will have eternity to mourn his loss.

Title: Tears in Rain
Description: Defeat Spirits at Stephen's Claim to Collect Teardrop Gems. Then report back to Artificer Wrightson in the Mourningdale Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Money. What else? I’m aware of how foolish it sounds, but I once had a lot invested in this place, and I can’t just leave empty-handed.
InProgressResponse: Scared of ghosts, stranger? Can’t say I blame you. But there’s no reward without risk!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well, aren’t you a marvel. I’ve been trying to get my hands on these gems since I first set foot in Mourningdale. They should fetch us a king's bounty.

Title: Silver Tongue, Golden Coins
Description: Recover the gold medallions from Padre Nuñez at his Mansion. Then report back to Artificer Wrightson in the Mourningdale Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You're clearly not afraid of a few Lost. And, in this case, you’ll be doing the world a favor. Who doesn’t love an altruist?
InProgressResponse: Just one more errand and we’ll have all the money we need to make ourselves scarce.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I think you’re my new best friend! Not only did you deliver the goods, but you punished that old snake Nunez.

Title: Hearth and Home
Description: Clear Weeper enemies from Porridgepot. Then report back to Constable Bayles in the Mourningdale Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You’re a true friend. A man’s home is his castle, but my first duty is to the citizens here. Keeping them safe is the priority.
InProgressResponse: Is something keeping you, friend? I’m eager to learn what’s become of my home in my absence.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You’re back? How fares my estate? Tell me it's not overrun with the Lost…

Title: Lost in the Flood
Description: Investigate the ruins in the Flooded Plains, and return found artifacts to Gildon in Mourningdale.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Probably not. The visions do not lie. But are they omens of the future or mere echoes of the past? I cannot be certain…
InProgressResponse: I must find my center, stranger. Without a center, there is only chaos and imbalance. Help me!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What you carry has brought clarity across time and space, stranger. These are artifacts from a lost age, but also omens of coming strife.

Title: The Broken Road
Description: Defeat Novaguard foot soldiers in the lookouts along the Ancient Road, and give their armor scraps to Gildon in Mourningdale.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I must see more. The Guardians are the ones who once did battle with our insolent foe. They employed protections we might yet recover.
InProgressResponse: My vision remains hazy, stranger. Bring me what I need, or I fear history may repeat itself…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Yes. Yes! I can see it now, blood and flame and the roiling red wrath of the Corruption, scourging its way across the land!

Title: Look Back in Anger
Description: Defeat Fineseer foot soldiers while climbing to the top of Vela, and show its treasure to Gildon in Mourningdale.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: A Watchtower, ancient and powerful, is your next destination. Vela. Your quarry stands proud and tall upon its peak.
InProgressResponse: The Watchers in the Tower… against what did they stand guard? Is it the same now as it was then?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Yes! Can you feel it, stranger? This is the moment. When I gaze through this glass, I look back across the ages to the time of… Ah!

Title: Misfortunes Multiply
Description: Defeat Musslebeard and the Seasong pirates in his charge. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in Mourningdale.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, of course. Our scouts. Antonio's notes say the pirates found themselves a new leader. A brute they call Musslebeard.
InProgressResponse: Hurry, friend. Musslebeard must be defeated. We can’t afford any distractions.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It’s done then? Musslebeard is destroyed and my Antonio avenged? Good. There is some solace in that.

Title: Corruption's Call
Description: Defeat the Redeyes and destroy Spewspitter's emblem in New Balefire, then return to Gildon in Mourningdale.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: An Ancient Lighthouse by the sea, calling like a siren. I believe the place is called “Bahia”. There is a totem there, screaming at its heart.
InProgressResponse: The scream still echoes through the souls of our neighbors, stranger. Make haste. No more may fall into the Corruption’s grip.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The fog has lifted from my eyes. The blur of past, present - all run together - no longer haunts my waking hours. There is clarity, but also still questions.

Title: Best Laid Plans
Description: Investigate key locations to the north that have been taken by the Wardogs. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in Mourningdale.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: One faction of Corrupted known as the Wardogs, they gather their forces up north. Make no mistake. They formulate strategy to march on us here in Grayvale.
InProgressResponse: Fortune favors the prepared, friend. If we’re going to stop the Corrupted, we need to know precisely what they’re planning.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Aha! Ore from the mines and maps plotting the Corrupted’s movements. It seems like they’ve stopped to equip themselves for a long fight.

Title: When it Rains, it Pours
Description: The Mourningdale settlement has been struck by tragedy and is in disarray. Constable Bayles will fill you in.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Disaster on top of disaster. The northern settlements have fallen, and a steady flow of refugees has us spread increasingly thin.
InProgressResponse: If you want to help us, speak to Fletcher. She'll know all the latest developments.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The Constable sent you? I’m not sure what we can do. Magistrate Wallace is being completely irrational, won't do a thing until she gets news about Antonio.

Title: Ode to Aeternum
Description: Pierre Auguste would like new tales of Aeternum, but is too timid to travel himself. Write a collection of odes to the scenic locations described in Pierre's guidebook.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That's what I'm told. I even bought a guidebook! I admit though, I'm a coward. Quelle folie... It must be frightful to die.
InProgressResponse: Have you visited the places in my guidebook?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, you're back! I'm burning with anticipation to read your contributions! Leilani's stories are wonderful, but she's retired. I yearn for new tales!

Title: Stone Cold Secrets
Description: Follow Leilani's clues, written on your map, to complete her last adventure and find three lost artifacts of Ancient construction.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I finally encountered a cliff I could not climb. Old age. I can't fight like I used to and my bones ache more each day. My adventuring days are pau.
InProgressResponse: Are you taking a rest? In-between tasks? Do let me know if you've found whatever secrets are locked inside those monuments.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well, look at this, Pierre! Our adventurer returns!

Title: The Last Mystery
Description: Travel to three locations marked on your map and investigate whether Leilani's key can be used at each.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They fit together into a larger artifact. It's got markings that I believe correspond to some Ancient sites I visited in my adventuring days.
InProgressResponse: Have you tested that artifact yet? I'm sure it all means something. What mysteries still lie hidden out there?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Look, Pierre! Our stalwart returns! Tell us, was it a key? What mysteries did it unlock?

Title: A Toast to Adventure
Description: Bring Leilani's Special Order to the Bartender in the Mourningdale Tavern.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ae! A toast to adventure. Faced with adversity, you still rise to the occasion. Reminds me of myself, when I was young and wild.
InProgressResponse: Hurry up and bring my order to the bartender, then! Don't hang about!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What's this? Another order from that woman upstairs? I thought I just saw her friend leaving…

Title: Amateur Adventurer
Description: Follow the trail of clues to find where Pierre has gone.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: My friends! Your stories of valor and verve have inspired me! Soon I will be back to regale you with tales of my own adventure to the north!
InProgressResponse: This is the note left by Pierre when he set out for adventure.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh thank the heavens, it's you! I've been stuck here for days! C’est la galère!

Title: Song of the Sea
Description: Find the Captain's lost Shanty Book and Hurdy-Gurdy.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Nothing like that. This be a tragic tale. Music’s me soul, y'see. But me crewmates never fancied me shanties.
InProgressResponse: I don't feel like meself these days. Me music be the only thing left to cling to out here.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Dancing dolphins! Me hurdy-gurdy! Ye've found her! An' me shanties as well! I don't know how I could repay ye.

Title: Village Champion
Description: Recover Lerato's Heirloom armor and sword from the Corrupted in Ceremony and return them to her at the crossroads.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Who else? My father was our town's defender. He died fighting, and the Corrupted took his weapon and his armor.
InProgressResponse: My father fought them in the streets, but for every one he struck down, five more would take their place.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're back! And with my father's armor as well! I'd recognize it anywhere! You've done me and my father a great kindness.

Title: Malign Dominion
Description: Find and destroy Malign Nodes at each of three Corrupt checkpoints along the road, then return to Harunobu at the crossroads. Some of these nodes are out of reach, you may need to bring a ranged weapon.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They must be! I may be just a hog farmer from Hibbotsfeld, but I recognize purpose when I see it!
InProgressResponse: Ah! Stay back! Oh, it's you again. Have you seen what those Corrupted are up to on the roads?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Yah! You have got to stop startling me like that! Did you see what those Corrupted are doing? Did you destroy their Malign Nodes?

Title: Makin' Bacon
Description: Harvest Mourning Pigs in Hibbotsfeld for Harunobu and return them to him at the crossroads.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Hogs! I'm a hog farmer. Always have been. I've got nothing left now! If only I had a way to get some of my precious pork…
InProgressResponse: Well? Did you go to my farm? I'd do it myself, but I'm just a hog farmer.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh, that's Hibbotsfeld pork if I've ever seen it. Look at that marbling!

Title: Soul Music
Description: Clear away the Withered around the Ancient Head so that Jan Jaansen can better hear the mysterious voice.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Are you sure? It's right there, playing at the edge of my hearing.
InProgressResponse: I almost had it for a moment! If only those Withered were driven away… It's something like a poem…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh, I heard it! For but a moment it was clear as the dawn! A song of epic proportions, a song of…

Title: Following the Bard's Song
Description: Search the coastal roads for Jan Jaansen
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Thanks for the inspiration! Here's to the brave soul that helped me to find my way on the roads north of the Settlement!
InProgressResponse: (Jan Jaansen wrote this note.)
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It's as though you heard me calling for you from so far away.

Title: New Perspective
Description: Get to the end of Presage Pier and look for inspiration for the next stanza of Jan's epic.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Worthy of ballads, I'm sure! Care to take on another task for me? The muse compels…
InProgressResponse: It all started with that voice, the one in the Ancient Head. Are you sure you couldn't hear it?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You are indeed a heroic sort, aren't you? Tell me then, what did you find?

Title: Harmonic Resonance
Description: Follow Jan Jaansen's inspiration to the location foretold in Jan's inspiration.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: But it's in the air, it's all around us! I can hear it ringing. It's telling me that the secret is at The Lighthouse.
InProgressResponse: (Jan seems lost in her thoughts. She hums a haunting tune.)
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: (The Ancient Sculpture instills a compulsion to reach towards its surface. As if the merest touch would reveal a cosmic sense of music. A wordless vision of vastness, and of escape.)

Title: Welcome to Mourningdale
Description: Find Harunobu, recently of Hibbotsfeld.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: So I've heard. More and more people falling through here lost their livelihoods. Some lost worse!
InProgressResponse: Have you checked in with those newcomers yet? Don't want them feeling left out after all that's happened to them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hey, it's {PlayerName}! Great to see you again. Want to try some of this pork? The facilities here are top-notch!

Title: The People in the Neighborhood
Description: Bring a sample of Harunobu's roast pork to Lerato.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I was at the brink of despair for a time there. But, that woman from the crossroads, Lerato? She was kind enough to travel here with me.
InProgressResponse: Hey {PlayerName}! Get that meat to Lerato while it's still hot!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh hello, what have you brought me? Ah, bless that Harunobu, he is so kind to me.

Title: Seasoned Adventurer
Description: Race Pierre home to the Mourningdale Settlement
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I intend to! I'll just take a moment to catch my breath, then I'll make haste back to my nice warm stool. Let's make a race of it! Bet I get back before you!
InProgressResponse: I've just tightened up my laces and checked my pockets. I'll be ready for the road soon. What will Leilani think of us when we get back and share our tale?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well, well! You made it back! I thought you might have been faster than me, but here we are! Those bluish shrines really make travel convenient, non?
